rationale: Basement flooding has caused structural damage to flooring and drywall, plus loss of stored contents — all covered property damage to the policyholder's residence and personal property.
claim_summary: Policyholder Sam Patel (POL-1004) discovered approximately 2 inches of water across entire basement upon return from work trip, causing buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall up to 1 foot, and multiple ruined storage boxes. Cause under investigation; requires urgent on-site inspection to determine water source and authorize mitigation to prevent further structural and content damage.

rationale: Wind damage to the roof shingles on the policyholder's own property with no third-party involvement or theft is clearly property damage.
claim_summary: Wind damage to four roof shingles above back porch overhang with estimated repair cost of $400 and no water intrusion. Damage is below the $2,500 deductible.
